card_promotions_super_markets.summary: Supermarket card offers JSON. NOTE (2026-09-14): this was a false-healthy bug (200 with empty data) — same root cause as the sl-bank-card-offers-docs repo: category=super_markets no longer exists (real categories are Premium_Offers/VISA_Offers/Mastercard_Offers), and the API needs headers locale: en + platform: web or it silently returns {"data":[],"total":N}. Fixed to a valid category + required headers. There is no server-side "supermarket" category anymore; true supermarket-only filtering needs client-side matching on company_name/description across all 3 categories.
